title: API Design
description: Practices for public interfaces and their stability.

practices.title: No silent breaking changes
practices.statement: Signature, behavior, and serialization changes to public surface are called out explicitly.

practices.title: Minimal surface
practices.statement: Export only what callers need; wide surfaces freeze accidents into contracts.

practices.title: Errors are contract
practices.statement: Failure modes are part of the API: documented, typed, and stable.

practices.title: Conservative defaults
practices.statement: Defaults choose the safe option; dangerous modes are opt-in.
